headline: New draft agent guide for adopting Future Defaults without a major upgrade
summary: Adds a draft markdown guide that the upgrade CLI copies into the agent's run directory and tells the agent to follow after a version update, or alone when the version is unchanged. It only shapes agent instructions (config setting, adoption, verification, return to shared.md for delivery); no executable code changes, so a short read of the wording is enough.
reason: New draft documentation consumed as agent instructions; it has no executable code, and the wording is low-risk and consistent with the shared and other guides.
risk_signals: instructions steer an AI agent's actions
